name: Curiosity Killed the Night
source:
A home once bought to cradle a new love now buries it beneath secrets soon to be uncovered.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

这栋原本为呵护新恋情而买下的爱巢，如今却将爱意深埋于即将揭晓的重重秘密之下。
